02 How a build comes together

Same process, every scenario

01

Map the workflow

Walk through the manual process step by step and mark exactly where a human is doing something a system could do.

02

Connect the tools

Wire up the platforms involved — CRM, sheets, chat, storefront — through their APIs or webhooks.

03

Automate & test

Build the scenario, run it against real edge cases, and confirm it fails safely, not silently.

04

Monitor & refine

Ship it, watch the run history, and tighten it as volume or requirements change.

05 About

Hi, I'm Naveed.

I'm an Automation & Integration Specialist with a strong focus on Monday.com and Make.com. I help businesses design smarter workflows, connect systems, and automate repetitive processes so teams can focus on growth instead of manual tasks.

As a Monday.com expert, I build custom boards, dashboards, and internal workflows tailored to team operations. Combined with my expertise in Make.com, Zapier, and n8n, I integrate CRMs, WordPress, e-commerce platforms, finance systems, and marketing tools into seamless automated workflows.

The scenarios on this page are live systems, not mockups — real triggers, real schedules, running today. If a task happens more than twice, it's probably worth automating. That's usually where a project with me starts.
